title: Return `user.microcloud` from `/1.0` even when user cannot edit other config
description:

```shell
N/A
```

### System info

N/A

### Instance log

N/A

### Expected behavior

When querying `/1.0` the `user.microcloud` key is returned for non-authenticated users.

https://github.com/canonical/lxd/blob/83189e2dfbd37344bb927c60474e3ff92dc23dab/lxd/api_1.0.go#L277-L289

But if the user is trusted and doesn't have permissions to edit the config, it doesn't get the see the `user.microcloud` key:

https://github.com/canonical/lxd/blob/83189e2dfbd37344bb927c60474e3ff92dc23dab/lxd/api_1.0.go#L450-L456

### Actual behavior

It seems to be that a trusted user who cannot edit config will get a permission denied error.

N/A

### Information to attach

- [ ] Any relevant kernel output (`dmesg`)
- [ ] Instance configuration (`lxc config show <instance> --expanded`)
- [ ] Main daemon log (at `/var/log/lxd/lxd.log` or `/var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/logs/lxd.log`)

author: tomponline

comments.author: markylaing
comments.body:
> a trusted user who cannot edit config will get a permission denied error.

They don't get a permission denied error, but they not be able to see the `user.microcloud` key.

In general I think we need to move config into the public server response (including some keys - maybe some from `oidc.*`?) and then populate it with all config if the user has edit permissions.

comments.author: tomponline
comments.body: Thanks. Yes I think the public API config should be returned in all cases, which does not seem to be the case right now.

comments.author: edlerd
comments.body:
